summary: Practise PPE checks, correct wearing, and defect reporting through workplace scenarios. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: PPE awareness training helps frontline workers, supervisors, and safety staff identify task hazards and check whether assigned protective equipment is suitable and serviceable. Participants practise reading task instructions, checking fit and condition—including respirator user seal checks—and reporting defects or handover concerns. They also learn about equipment limitations, safe storage, and when to stop work and seek guidance.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who wear, issue, check, or oversee protective equipment during everyday work. It is designed for frontline roles and safety staff who need practical PPE awareness for routine tasks and handovers.
audience: Laboratory technicians using task-assigned gloves, eye protection
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace tasks and the safety instructions used in your work setting is helpful. No coding or programming is required.
